categories.main_business_segments: Dekon Food and Agriculture Group operates primarily in three segments: pig farming, poultry farming, and ancillary products. The pig segment includes market hogs, breeding pigs, piglets, and boar semen. The poultry segment focuses on yellow-feathered broilers, chicks, and eggs. The ancillary products segment involves livestock slaughtering and sales of fresh meat, feed ingredients, and related products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced breeding technologies, including a nucleus breeding herd with improved genetic performance. It uses precision nutrition and feed technology with dynamic raw material databases and value-based procurement. Biosecurity and disease prevention are emphasized through strict farm site selection, disinfection, virus testing, and disease eradication programs. Poultry breeding involves gene banks, breeding bases, and patented farming technologies. The company operates both self-operated farms and family farm models for pig and poultry farming.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Dekon's customers include external buyers of pigs and poultry, butchers in farmers’ markets, distributors of school meals, fresh supermarket distributors, and food processing factories. The company also cooperates with farm owners in pig and poultry farming. Its products serve the meat production and food processing industries primarily within China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in the People's Republic of China, with its head office in Chengdu, Sichuan Province, and a principal place of business in Hong Kong. Its subsidiaries and farms are located across various provinces including Sichuan, Chongqing, Guangdong, Jiangsu, and others. The company’s market and operations are focused on the Chinese domestic market.
categories.supply_chain_position: Dekon operates a vertically integrated supply chain covering feed production, breeding, multiplication, farming, and sales. It controls upstream breeding and feed production, midstream farming, and downstream sales and slaughtering, positioning itself across the entire livestock and poultry production value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological empowerment, management reform, and biosecurity enhancement. It invests heavily in R&D with a team of 186 professionals focusing on breeding, feed, nutrition, and health management. Strategic initiatives include improving breeding genetics, precision nutrition, disease prevention, and sustainable farming models. The company also benchmarks international best practices and emphasizes talent development and ESG initiatives such as rural revitalization and sustainable agriculture.
categories.revenue_model: Dekon generates revenue primarily through the sale of live pigs, breeding pigs, piglets, poultry products (broilers, chicks, eggs), and ancillary products including fresh meat and feed ingredients. It also earns fees from family farm models where it provides inputs and technical support. The company’s revenue is largely transactional based on product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Dekon is a leading livestock and poultry enterprise in China, ranking third nationwide in yellow-feathered broiler market share. It is recognized for its advanced breeding technology and efficient production. The company competes with other large-scale pig and poultry producers in China, leveraging cost advantages, disease prevention capabilities, and integrated operations to maintain a strong market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Dekon reported revenue of RMB 22.46 billion, a 39% increase from 2023, and a net profit of RMB 4.20 billion compared to a loss in the previous year. The company has shown significant growth and improved profitability driven by increased sales volume and efficiency gains. Total assets reached RMB 23.06 billion with equity of RMB 8.59 billion. The company’s financial ratios indicate improved liquidity, reduced gearing, and strong returns on equity and assets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dekon emphasizes high-quality breeding stock with superior genetic performance, precision nutrition, and strict biosecurity to ensure product quality and safety. Its vertically integrated model allows for control over the entire production process, enhancing efficiency and cost competitiveness. The company’s innovative breeding and farming technologies, combined with strong R&D and management expertise, differentiate it in the market. It also focuses on sustainable development and rural revitalization, linking industrial growth with farmer income improvement.
